
	<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/luoht/p/20026520" title="发布于 2026-05-12 22:16">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">高性能百度OCR ONNX Runtime C#实现</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="heading-element" dir="auto"><span class="mr-2 flex-self-stretch d-none d-md-block no-wrap overflow-x-hidden"><span class="mr-2 flex-self-stretch d-none d-md-block no-wrap overflow-x-hidden"><a class="d-block overflow-x-hidden color-fg-default" href="https://github.com/meloht/RapidOCRSharpOnnx" data-pjax="#repo-content-pjax-container" data-turbo-frame="repo-content-turbo-frame" rel="noopener nofollow">RapidOCRSharpOnnx</a>&nbsp;是一个基于OpenCV与ONNX Runtime 实现的PaddleOCR C#开源推理库，参考了<a href="https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR" rel="noopener nofollow">RapidOCR</a>&nbsp;的实现，重新使用C#实现，并做了大量性能优化与架构重新设计，方便多种ONNX Runtime 执行提供程序部署</span></span></p>
<h1><span class="mr-2 flex-self-stretch d-none d-md-block no-wrap overflow-x-hidden"><span class="mr-2 flex-self-stretch d-none d-md-block no-wrap overflow-x-hidden">特性</span></span></h1>
<ul>
<li>不依赖于具体的模型，直接导入需要的PP-OCR模型，识别指定的语言，PP-OCRv5模型支持识别106种语言，只需要将PP-OCRv5模型导出为onnx格式，就可以离线运行</li>
<li>支持的ONNX Runtime 执行提供程序：Execution Provider&nbsp;CPU, CUDA / TensorRT, OpenVINO, CoreML, DirectML</li>
<li>支持批量识别，并提供异步执行性能优化，大幅提高批量执行性能</li>
<li>使用OpenCVSharp4 进行图像处理操作</li>
<li>绘制识别结果图片使用SkiaSharp</li>
<li>PP-OCR 版本支持：<a href="https://www.paddleocr.ai/v3.0.0/version3.x/pipeline_usage/OCR.html" rel="noopener nofollow">PP-OCRv5</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://www.paddleocr.ai/v3.0.0/version3.x/pipeline_usage/PP-ChatOCRv4.html" rel="noopener nofollow">PP-OCRv4</a></li>
<li>推理引擎：<a href="https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime" rel="noopener nofollow">ONNX Runtime</a>&nbsp;是一个跨平台的机器学习模型加速器</li>
</ul>
<h1>OCR 示例</h1>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/65748/202605/65748-20260512213311220-126607639.png" alt="res_book" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span class="mr-2 flex-self-stretch d-none d-md-block no-wrap overflow-x-hidden"><span class="mr-2 flex-self-stretch d-none d-md-block no-wrap overflow-x-hidden"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/65748/202605/65748-20260512213413391-1814849419.png" alt="res_csharp" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/65748/202605/65748-20260512213510441-926691959.png" alt="res_yongledadian" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>RapidOCRSharpOnnx使用</h1>
<h2>1 导出模型为onnx格式</h2>
<p>如何转换PP-OCR模型为onnx格式，可以参考PP-OCR官网<a href="https://www.paddleocr.ai/v3.0.0/version3.x/deployment/obtaining_onnx_models.html" rel="noopener nofollow">Obtaining ONNX Models</a>, 或者直接从RapidOCR的魔塔社区下载<a href="https://www.modelscope.cn/models/RapidAI/RapidOCR/tree/master/onnx" rel="noopener nofollow">Model List</a>.</p>
<h2>2 安装RapidOCRSharpOnnx组件并加载模型</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Install Nuget packages RapidOCRSharpOnnx, OnnxRuntime, OpenCvSharp4.runtime</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>CPU 推理</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dotnet add package RapidOCRSharpOnnx
dotnet add package OpenCvSharp4.runtime.win
dotnet add package Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> RapidOCRSharp ocr = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RapidOCRSharp(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ExecutionProviderCPU(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OcrConfig(detectPath, recPath, LangRec.CH, OCRVersion.PPOCRV5, clsMobilePath)));</pre>
</div>
<h3>CoreML 推理</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dotnet add package RapidOCRSharpOnnx
dotnet add package OpenCvSharp4.runtime.osx.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.15</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">x64
dotnet add package Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> RapidOCRSharp ocr = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RapidOCRSharp(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ExecutionProviderCoreML(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OcrConfig(detectPath, recPath, LangRec.CH, OCRVersion.PPOCRV5, clsMobilePath)));</pre>
</div>
<h3>CUDA/TensorRT 推理</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dotnet add package RapidOCRSharpOnnx
dotnet add package OpenCvSharp4.runtime.win
dotnet add package Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.Gpu.Windows</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> RapidOCRSharp ocr = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RapidOCRSharp(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ExecutionProviderCUDA(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OcrConfig(detectPath, recogPath, LangRec.CH, OCRVersion.PPOCRV5, clsPath), deviceId));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> RapidOCRSharp ocr = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RapidOCRSharp(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ExecutionProviderTensorRT(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OcrConfig(detectPath, recogPath, LangRec.CH, OCRVersion.PPOCRV5, clsPath), deviceId));</pre>
</div>
<h3>DirectML 推理</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dotnet add package RapidOCRSharpOnnx
dotnet add package OpenCvSharp4.runtime.win
dotnet add package Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.DirectML</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> RapidOCRSharp ocr = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RapidOCRSharp(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ExecutionProviderDirectML(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OcrConfig(detectPath, recogPath, LangRec.EN, OCRVersion.PPOCRV5, clsPath), deviceId));</pre>
</div>
<h3>OpenVINO 推理</h3>
<div>&nbsp;
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dotnet add package RapidOCRSharpOnnx
dotnet add package OpenCvSharp4.runtime.win
dotnet add package Intel.ML.OnnxRuntime.OpenVino</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> RapidOCRSharp ocr = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RapidOCRSharp(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ExecutionProviderOpenVINO(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OcrConfig(detectPath, recogPath, LangRec.EN, OCRVersion.PPOCRV5, clsPath), IntelDeviceType.NPU));</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>基本的API使用</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> RapidOCRSharp ocr = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RapidOCRSharp(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ExecutionProviderDirectML(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OcrConfig(detectPath, recogPath, LangRec.EN, OCRVersion.PPOCRV5, clsPath), _deviceId));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> savePath = $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">res_{Path.GetFileName(imgPath)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ocr.RecognizeText(imgPath, savePath);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result: {result.ToString()}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<h3>批量识别图片</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> RapidOCRSharp ocr = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RapidOCRSharp(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ExecutionProviderDirectML(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OcrConfig(detectPath, recogPath, LangRec.CH, OCRVersion.PPOCRV5, clsPath), _deviceId));
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = Directory.GetFiles(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">C:\code\model\OCRTestImages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
 Stopwatch sw </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Stopwatch();
 sw.Start();
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> resPath =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ocr.BatchParallelAsync(list.ToList(), saveDir, receiveAction: ReceiveResult);
 sw.Stop();
 Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">BatchAsync Time: {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds} ms</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ReceiveResult(OcrBatchResult batchResult)
{
    Console.WriteLine(batchResult.ToString());
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">------------------------------------------------------------</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>批量识别使用Foreach API</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task TestBatchForeachAsync()
        {

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> detectPath = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">D:\code\RapidOCRSharpOnnx\RapidOCRSharpOnnx.TestCommon\Models\ch_PP-OCRv5_det_mobile.onnx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> recogPath = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">D:\code\RapidOCRSharpOnnx\RapidOCRSharpOnnx.TestCommon\Models\ch_PP-OCRv5_rec_mobile.onnx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> clsPath = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">D:\code\RapidOCRSharpOnnx\RapidOCRSharpOnnx.TestCommon\Models\ch_PP-LCNet_x0_25_textline_ori_cls_mobile.onnx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> RapidOCRSharp ocr = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RapidOCRSharp(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ExecutionProviderDirectML(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OcrConfig(detectPath, recogPath, LangRec.CH, OCRVersion.PPOCRV5, clsPath), _deviceId));
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = Directory.GetFiles(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">D:\code\model\OCRTestImages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> res = ocr.BatchForeachAsync(list.ToList(), <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">D:\code\model\OCRTestImagesResults</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> item <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> res)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(item.TextBlocks);
            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        }</span></pre>
</div>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>测试电脑</h2>
<p><strong>Windows 11 Pro OS Version 25H2</strong></p>
<p><strong>CPU： Intel Core Ultra 9 285k 3.7GHz</strong></p>
<p><strong>内存：DDR5 128GB speed 4400MT/s</strong></p>
<p><strong>硬盘：SSD 2TB</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>测试数据</h2>
<p dir="auto"><strong>图片:&nbsp;60 张图片 (图片大小: 1180x92)</strong></p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>PP-OCR 模型:&nbsp;ch_PP-OCRv5_det_mobile, ch_PP-OCRv5_rec_mobile, ch_PP-LCNet_x0_25_textline_ori_cls_mobile</strong></p>
<h2 class="heading-element" dir="auto">PaddleSharp 测试结果</h2>
<p><strong>CPU 推理时间 :&nbsp;48.1769278s</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/65748/202605/65748-20260512221153724-232519805.png" alt="Snipaste_2026-05-12_22-11-36" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="heading-element" dir="auto">PaddleOCR&nbsp;测试结果</h2>
<p><strong>CPU 推理时间 : 62.6685s</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/65748/202605/65748-20260512221228474-549840936.png" alt="Snipaste_2026-05-12_22-12-18" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="heading-element" dir="auto">RapidOCR&nbsp;测试结果</h2>
<p><strong>CPU 推理时间 :&nbsp;17.9634s</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/65748/202605/65748-20260512221306939-906937513.png" alt="Snipaste_2026-05-12_22-12-44" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="heading-element" dir="auto">RapidOCRSharpOnnx&nbsp;测试结果</h2>
<p><strong>CPU 推理时间 :&nbsp;9.2447s</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/65748/202605/65748-20260512221343732-722861639.png" alt="Snipaste_2026-05-12_22-13-29" loading="lazy"></p>
